tr-2P4G.title: Landmark: mosques with tall minarets
tr-2P4G.summary: A Muslim-majority country, so most towns have a mosque. Tall minarets are extremely common and a strong clue.

tr-3Nhk.title: Google car: Gen 4 truck mainly far east and
tr-3Nhk.summary: Gen 4 truck coverage is mostly in the far east and along the south coast, with small pockets in the west and one in the north.

tr-4XWl.title: Pole: snow pole black-orange-black-white
tr-4XWl.summary: Snow poles are coloured black, orange, black, white from top to bottom, with small red reflectors.

tr-5hkj.title: Sign: light blue and grey tourist signs
tr-5hkj.summary: Light blue and grey tourist signs, arrow-shaped or rectangular with a half circle on top, on the island of Bozcaada.

tr-5jfy.title: Water tanks: horizontal on top of vertical
tr-5jfy.summary: A horizontal tank on top of a vertical tank, mainly in a line along the south coast and up to Elâzığ.

tr-7HDD.title: Houses: whitewashed, flat roofs, blue trim
tr-7HDD.summary: Around Bodrum, whitewashed buildings with flat roofs, often with blue details or unpainted stone walls.

tr-9RlL.title: Sign: wide letter spacing on direction signs
tr-9RlL.summary: Direction signs use a distinct font with noticeably wide gaps between letters.

tr-BSFD.title: Highway: four lanes, no divider
tr-BSFD.summary: Four-lane divided highways with no physical divider, only double middle lines, are almost only in the eastern half. Highways with real dividers like guardrails can still occur in the east.

tr-Ce1R.title: Google car: white Gen 4, tiny sliver of back
tr-Ce1R.summary: In newer Gen 4 coverage the car is white and only a tiny sliver of its back is visible. It has a short antenna or none.

tr-CuUl.title: Ground: brick pavement of one tile shape
tr-CuUl.summary: Brick paving is very common in towns, with bricks of the shape in the picture.

tr-D1EC.title: Road lines: mostly white, sometimes yellow
tr-D1EC.summary: Most roads have white lines, but yellow lines (fully yellow or yellow with white) are not unusual.

tr-DDP9.title: Roads: lots of divided highways
tr-DDP9.summary: Divided highways are extremely common, especially compared with other Mediterranean countries.

tr-DPuZ.title: Guardrail: both A-type and B-type
tr-DPuZ.summary: Both guardrail types appear: A-type (rounded edges) and B-type (square edges). B-type helps in 50-50s with Mediterranean countries. Seeing both rules out all southern European and Middle Eastern countries except Montenegro and Israel/West Bank.

differs.how: Israel and the West Bank also have both types

tr-EjNo.title: Google car: grey pickup truck
tr-EjNo.summary: A grey pickup truck in some Gen 4 coverage. Similar trucks exist in Georgia, Senegal, Rwanda, Kenya, Ghana and Paraguay.

tr-G6h2.title: Landscape: surrounded by greenhouses
tr-G6h2.summary: If greenhouses are all around, you are probably on the south coast west of Adana.

tr-Imt4.title: Plants: tea plantations in the northeast
tr-Imt4.summary: Tea plantations are common in the northeastern Rize province.

tr-N5vS.title: Pole: metal ladder or mesh pole
tr-N5vS.summary: Metal poles shaped like a ladder or with a mesh pattern are extremely common.

tr-NL3Y.title: Sign: green street names with raised letters
tr-NL3Y.summary: In Bursa, street signs are green with slightly raised letters. Fences and guardrails may also be painted green.

tr-QOm1.title: Chevron: red on white, arrow tip free of edge
tr-QOm1.summary: Usually red on white, though regional variants exist. The arrow tip normally does not touch the chevron's edge, and some have a neon yellow border.

tr-QuGQ.title: Landscape: giant dormant volcano plus a
tr-QuGQ.summary: Mount Ararat (Ağrı Dağı) is a dormant volcano in the far east and the country's tallest peak. It often appears with smaller Küçük Ağrı to the southeast.

tr-RsRd.title: Roofs: low pyramid sheet metal, far east
tr-RsRd.summary: Sheet metal roofs shaped like low pyramids, mostly in the far east around the big lake.

tr-X02u.title: Landscape: tall sandstone monoliths with
tr-X02u.summary: Göreme, west of Kayseri, has tall sandstone monoliths with ancient dwellings carved into them.

tr-ZAFL.title: Sign: blue street name with small round top
tr-ZAFL.summary: Street signs in the Ankara province are blue with a small round top. Very rarely also in Giresun. Newer signs may be red.

tr-Zdx7.title: Road numbers: provincial codes on km markers
tr-Zdx7.summary: Provincial roads aren't labelled on the map, but their km markers start with the two-digit province code, roughly alphabetical from 01 to 76 (newer provinces are out of order).

tr-aoIU.title: Houses: large light uneven sandstone blocks
tr-aoIU.summary: Many buildings in the Nevşehir province are made of large, light, unevenly coloured sandstone blocks.

tr-bl0n.title: Sign: red street name, coloured bottom strip
tr-bl0n.summary: Red street signs with a coloured bottom strip and a white arrow and numbers at bottom right appear in several cities. A single-headed arrow pointing both ways almost certainly means Istanbul. A one-way arrow plus red house numbers also means Istanbul.

tr-bo5u.title: Camera: low smallcam
tr-bo5u.summary: Some Gen 4 smallcam coverage is mounted lower than usual, with a big round blur and a small bump at the front. The blur can be fully transparent and hard to notice.

tr-cKHH.title: Pole: six-digit code on a small plate
tr-cKHH.summary: In the European part, except Istanbul, utility poles carry a 6-digit code, often on a small plate under the yellow electricity warning plate.

tr-cb18.title: Landscape: huge lake, dry grassy hills
tr-cb18.summary: By far the biggest lake in the country, with a semi-arid landscape: dry grassy hills, a few trees and farmland near the shore.

tr-ccW4.title: Chevron: narrow, red and white
tr-ccW4.summary: Narrow red-and-white chevrons are sometimes seen. South Africa has nearly identical ones.

tr-cf7P.title: Water tanks: white spherical
tr-cf7P.summary: White spherical water tanks in the southeast, mainly south of Batman.

tr-eLMh.title: Road: narrow single lane, jagged rock
tr-eLMh.summary: Along the western shores of Lake Beyşehir and Lake Eğirdir: a small single-lane road with jagged exposed rock and pines to the west. The Eğirdir road has a centre line.

tr-eM9J.title: Sign: stop sign reading DUR
tr-eM9J.summary: Stop signs say "DUR", which is unique to this country.

tr-eWbd.title: Google car: Gen 3, never an antenna
tr-eWbd.summary: In the older Gen 3 coverage (blurrier, softer colours), the car never has an antenna.

tr-fxRl.title: Landscape: river valleys with steep barren
tr-fxRl.summary: River valleys with steep, barren, rocky cliffs between Erzurum and Artvin, and in the southeast near Hakkâri.

tr-h0ZV.title: Road: dead straight, winter Gen 3, reeds
tr-h0ZV.summary: The D525 south of Söke is perfectly straight, running south-southwest to north-northeast, with winter Gen 3 coverage and lots of reeds.

tr-hFfd.title: Roofs: metal, mostly east
tr-hFfd.summary: Metal roofs are most common in the east.

tr-hyYZ.title: Plants: vineyards in the west
tr-hyYZ.summary: Most vineyards are in a region east of Izmir.

tr-ioW2.title: Plants: sunflowers in the northwest
tr-ioW2.summary: Sunflowers are mainly in the northwest.

tr-jAbk.title: Ground: dark volcanic rocks
tr-jAbk.summary: Dark volcanic rocks are common between Şanlıurfa and Diyarbakır.

tr-l1rB.title: Sign: flat green street names, no border
tr-l1rB.summary: In Bolu, street signs are green too, but completely flat and with no border.

tr-l81d.title: Plants: pines near the Mediterranean coast
tr-l81d.summary: Turkish pines (pinus brutia) are mainly near the Mediterranean coast. They look much like Aleppo pines, which are rare here but common in other Mediterranean countries.

tr-lAmr.title: Roofs: flat, southeast and south coast
tr-lAmr.summary: Flat roofs are mostly in the southeast and, less so, along the south coast.

tr-lm-2585.title: Bollard: municipality code letters
tr-lm-2585.summary: Bollards carry municipality letters tied to phone area codes, for example ABB (312), IBB (212, 216), BBB (224), KBB (352 round logo, 332 tree logo) and MBB (252).

tr-lm-2984.title: Sign: extra blue space above the triangle
tr-lm-2984.summary: Warning signs have extra blue space above the triangle compared with other countries.

tr-lm-641931.title: Highway: divided road, hazy sunrise
tr-lm-641931.summary: The E99 south of Şanlıurfa is a divided highway with slightly hazy Gen 4 sunrise coverage, flat agricultural land and a south-north direction.

tr-lm-740287.title: Sign: like the red street signs
tr-lm-740287.summary: Antalya street signs are very similar to Istanbul's, but have a rounded logo in the bottom left.

tr-lm-740288.title: Landscape: huge range to the west
tr-lm-740288.summary: Antalya has a huge mountain range to the west, sometimes snow-topped.

tr-m6mB.title: Water tanks: vertical
tr-m6mB.summary: Vertical water tanks are in most of the country but not common along the south and west coasts.

tr-n73Y.title: Chevron: yellow on black, west and far east
tr-n73Y.summary: Yellow-on-black chevrons are mainly in and around the western Balıkesir province and the far eastern Kars province. Rarely elsewhere.

tr-niOS.title: Chevron: black on yellow
tr-niOS.summary: Black-on-yellow chevrons are mainly north of Izmir.

tr-os4B.title: Landscape: uncultivated grass valleys
tr-os4B.summary: In the northeast: wild grassland in valleys among round hills, with very few trees. In Gen 3 the grass is deep green and very distinct, but in Gen 4 it looks drier.

tr-p55d.title: Road: grainy salt-and-pepper asphalt
tr-p55d.summary: Many roads have grainy pavement with a salt-and-pepper texture.

tr-pFHY.title: Road numbers: O-roads and D-roads on km markers
tr-pFHY.summary: O-roads show an O, a hyphen and the number on km markers. D-roads omit the D and show a 3-digit number, the section number on top and the kilometre at the bottom. Section numbers generally rise towards the southeast.

tr-pPdr.title: Landscape: lusher, forested north
tr-pPdr.summary: The north is much lusher and more forested than the rest of the country.

tr-q9pP.title: Houses: tall, squarish apartment blocks
tr-q9pP.summary: Tall, somewhat square apartment blocks are very common.

tr-qFBV.title: Chevron: black and yellow
tr-qFBV.summary: At intersections, a black and yellow chevron with several arrows pointing upward.

tr-qZq7.title: Plants: olive trees on the Mediterranean coast
tr-qZq7.summary: Olive trees are mainly on the Mediterranean coast.

tr-qrJL.title: Bollard: plain white rectangle, red reflector
tr-qrJL.summary: Simple rectangular, plain white bollard with a red reflector on the front, thin from the side. A rare yellow version appears in snowy areas. Romania has similar ones but far fewer.

differs.how: Similar bollards, but much rarer there

tr-qs57.title: Language: dotless ı, Ç Ş Ğ Ö Ü
tr-qs57.summary: A distinct look with Ç, Ş (hook below), Ö, Ü (two dots), Ğ (curved mark) and especially the dotless ı, plus a capital İ with a dot. The dotless ı is essentially unique to this language.

tr-ryy2.title: Plate: long white, blue strip on left
tr-ryy2.summary: The standard European-style plate: long, white, with a blue strip on the left.

tr-sLHs.title: Water tanks: square with angled corners
tr-sLHs.summary: Square water tanks with angled corners, in the south from about İskenderun to Şanlıurfa.

tr-vhPr.title: Phone numbers: first digit 2 west to 4 east
tr-vhPr.summary: Area codes follow an easy pattern for guessing the region: the first digit goes from 2 in the west to 4 in the east. Codes starting with 5 are not regional.

tr-wAF5.title: Roofs: tiled, western two thirds
tr-wAF5.summary: Tiled roofs are mostly in the western two thirds. For roof tips to be reliable, most visible roofs should be of that type.

tr-wPss.title: Sign: dark blue bulging street name with emblem
tr-wPss.summary: In the Izmir province, street signs are dark blue, noticeably bulge outwards, and often carry the city emblem in white at the top.

tr-xnIM.title: Sign: red oval street names and house numbers
tr-xnIM.summary: In Trabzon and Yalvaç, street signs are red and oval, and house numbers match.

tr-y8wc.title: Landscape: dry southeast, lush north
tr-y8wc.summary: Dry in the southeast, Mediterranean in the southwest, and greener and more forested in the north. The most typical scene is semi-arid rolling or flat farmland with almost no plants besides crops. The country is very diverse.

tr-yVok.title: Plants: cotton in the south-east
tr-yVok.summary: Cotton is mainly grown around Şanlıurfa.
